name: taskforce
description: Work on your TaskForce issues in your own Claude Code: list the issues assigned to you, take one, code or write, and leave a comment. Through the MCP server of your TaskForce instance, as you, with your rights.

taskforce_url.title: TaskForce API address
taskforce_url.description: The API address of your TaskForce instance, without /api. For example https://api.taskforce-project.fr, or http://localhost:8080 for a local instance.

taskforce_workspace.title: Workspace
taskforce_workspace.description: The slug of your workspace, as it appears in the address of the app.

taskforce_token.title: Personal access token
taskforce_token.description: Create one in TaskForce: Settings > Agents > Claude Code in your terminal. It starts with tfp_, acts as you, and only works with the MCP server.
